controller: i.MX95 Cortex-M7 PX4 HITL, system ID 1
companion: i.MX95 Linux, Neutron YOLOv8s, ROS 2 DDS guidance
simulation: Windows ProjectAirSim 1.0.1; GPU rendering and NVENC video

canopy_occlusion.tracker: matched develop packages, class-independent association, no camera compensation

camera_motion_experiment.note: Sparse similarity compensation added to XYAH ByteTrack; not full BoT-SORT. Raw detector replay without compensation retained the selected ID across the visible-frame live failure.

urban_challenge.failure: Selected identity lost near U-turn; normal failure landing and disarm. Earlier braking/headway changes also failed and were not promoted.

staging_failure.cause: Old dependency .deb used with newer tracker structure in a temporary runtime
staging_failure.resolution: Explicitly build bytetrack and target-tracker packages together; verify matching structure layouts before staging

next_steps: Qualify a vehicle-specific appearance encoder on Neutron; combine appearance with spatial and motion gating for same-object recovery.
Use a full evaluated association implementation; compare motion-only OC-SORT and appearance-assisted BoT-SORT/Deep OC-SORT on identical recorded detections.
Evaluate calibrated camera/pose-assisted target motion and turn-aware state estimation; do not replace observations with unmarked predictions.
Evaluate visibility-aware trajectory control after identity is reliable; keep the existing selected-loss hold until recovery is qualified.
Add rendered actor-identity ground truth and HOTA/IDF1 evaluation for crossings and visually similar cars; vary vehicle appearance as well as retaining identical-car challenges.
measurement_limits: Rear-formation references use elapsed-time fixture commands and asynchronous aircraft poses, not exact render-tick ground truth.
Stable track ID alone does not establish correct physical identity among the 21 cloned Car_01 actors.
A one-minute single-car rear-following pass is not an occlusion or multi-car tracking pass.
